Good morning, and welcome to the plant. Please take a safety card at the entrance. The meeting room is on the first floor, next to the coffee machine. There is an elevator behind you, on the left. Your badge is in the blue box on the table. If you go to the production area, there are safety glasses at the door. Thank you.

Attention, please. This is a safety announcement. There is a test of the alarm today, at three in the afternoon. It is only a test. During the test there is no production in the plant. Please stay at your desk, or outside the yellow line. The test is five minutes. Thank you.

The visitor arrives at the entrance of the plant. He takes a safety card and safety glasses. He goes to the first floor for the meeting. After the meeting he visits the production area. He stays outside the yellow line, next to the machines.
